prompts.prompt:
[SCENE]
desk-workspace preset. Late afternoon golden hour, private study corner beside a large window with sheer linen curtains diffusing direct sunlight. Interior of a minimal Korean apartment, warm and lived-in.

[PRODUCT PLACEMENT]
No product. Scene is purely atmospheric — open laptop at left edge of frame, spiral notebook with pen resting across open pages centered on raw oak wood desk, ceramic mug of tea partially visible at far right corner.

[HUMAN ELEMENT]
20-something Korean person shown from behind at three-quarter angle, or cropped to hands only resting on notebook and keyboard — face never visible. Natural posture, slight forward lean suggesting focused study. Hands show natural skin texture, relaxed finger positioning on pen or keyboard.

[ENVIRONMENT DETAILS]
Raw oak desk surface with soft grain texture. Sheer ivory linen curtains catching afternoon breeze. Small potted plant — trailing pothos — at window corner. Worn paperback books stacked at desk edge. Soft pencil marks visible on open notebook pages. Warm afternoon light casting long diagonal shadow across desk surface.

[LIGHTING]
45° camera-right motivated practical light from large west-facing window, 4200K mixed warm daylight-and-interior ambient. Large softbox diffusion quality replicated by sheer curtain layer. Soft falloff with gradient transition across desk surface. Deep shadow side with selective fill on left. Golden rim light catching edge of person's shoulder and hair.

[LENS & CAMERA]
Shot on 50mm standard, aperture f/2.8, shallow depth of field with focus on hands and notebook center, background softly bokeh'd into warm amber blur. Slight natural vignette at frame corners.

[ATMOSPHERE]
Intimate, quietly focused, nostalgic warmth. Still afternoon air. Sense of productive solitude — the kind of afternoon that feels unhurried. Dust motes faintly visible in window light beam.

[COLOR PALETTE]
Amber honey gold, warm ivory cream, muted sage green from plant. Low-contrast warm tonal range, no cool tones anywhere in frame.

[STYLE REFERENCE]
In the style of Brittany Ambridge, Pia Ulin, James Merrell. Editorial lifestyle commercial photography.

[QUALITY MARKERS]
Cinematic depth, hyper-realistic fabric and wood grain textures, natural hand skin details, film-like tonal rendering with subtle grain, no digital sterility.

[AVOID]
no AI artifacts, no warped or smeared text, no fake words baked into the image,
no plastic look, no waxy surface, no cartoonish rendering,
no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no melted geometry, no doubled subjects,
no oversaturated HDR, no HDR halos, no oversharpened look,
no flat fluorescent lighting, no harsh on-camera flash,
no generic stock photography poses, no cliché compositions,
no random unrelated brand logos, no watermarks, no signatures,
no AI sheen on hair or skin, no doll-like rendering, no airbrush look,
no flat solid color bands, no empty rectangular areas, no dull gradient zones,
no AI uncanny faces, no warped facial geometry, no asymmetric eyes,
no extra teeth, no melted facial features, no warped fingers or hands,
no plastic skin, no orange-tan skin, no over-smoothed retouching,
no doll eyes, no misaligned facial features, no rubber-like skin texture,
no stale stock photography aesthetic, no synthetic stock-photo look,
no over-staged feeling, no unrealistically clean environments,
no clipart elements, no obviously composited backgrounds,
no visible text, no letters, no numbers, no typography anywhere in frame, no notebook writing legible.

resolution: 2k
